entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: The Digital Age, spanning approximately 2001 CE to 2030 CE, represents a pivotal sub-period within the broader Contemporary era, as classified by the Annals of the World's Dewey-style system (division 963). This era is fundamentally defined by the pervasive integration of digital technologies, the internet, and sophisticated computational systems into nearly every facet of human existence. It marks a profound shift from the Information Age's nascent digital infrastructure to a fully interconnected global society, characterized by instant communication, vast data proliferation, and unprecedented technological convergence. Its core significance lies in democratizing access to information, transforming economic models, and reshaping social interactions on a global scale.
